case_goal: Verify that a logged-in user can open and view an existing project from the desktop.
summary: Log in to Collabtive with admin credentials, navigate through the desktop interface, and open the 'test' project to verify its details are displayed.

steps.expected_result: Login page is displayed with username field, password field, stay logged in checkbox, and login button.
Stay logged in checkbox is toggled (state remains unchanged on page).
Redirect to Desktop page with URL http://collabtive-old.local:8084/index.php?mode=login and page title 'Desktop @ Collabtive'.
Add project form becomes visible (input fields for name, description, end date, etc.).

Navigate to project page with URL http://collabtive-old.local:8084/manageproject.php?action=showproject&id=1 and page title 'Project test @ Collabtive', showing project details including budget, customer, and due date.
